_description: Postmortem entries from improvement skill sessions. Each line is a self-contained JSON object following the postmortem entry format in references/postmortem-template.md.

summary: cargo xtask wasm check failed during discovery across 19 crates due to missing host toolchain target wasm32-unknown-unknown
root_cause: Executed target-specific compilation task without pre-verifying that the wasm32-unknown-unknown target was installed via rustup.

checklist_answers.error_message_and_code: error: 19 crate(s) failed the wasm check; exit code 1
checklist_answers.environment_verified: No, assumed wasm32-unknown-unknown was installed globally
checklist_answers.new_dependency: No new crates; requires rustup component target wasm32-unknown-unknown
checklist_answers.pre_build_validation: Run rustup target list --installed or rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown before cargo xtask wasm

evidence.summary: error: 19 crate(s) failed the wasm check: error: process didn't exit successfully: target/debug/xtask.exe wasm (exit code: 1)
Only x86_64-pc-windows-msvc was installed on host toolchain.

summary: cargo xtask ci failed at test stage due to untranslated menu strings and untranslated error messages in i18n catalogs
root_cause: Registered new engine commands in command_specs() and introduced a new EngineError::Other(...) string literal without updating ui-egui's language catalogs (*.tsv), which are strictly enforced by complete_languages_translate_every_menu_string and complete_languages_translate_every_message in CI.

checklist_answers.error_message_and_code: thread i18n::tests::complete_languages_translate_every_menu_string panicked: ja: 4 untranslated menu strings; thread i18n::tests::complete_languages_translate_every_message panicked: es: 2 untranslated messages; exit code 101
checklist_answers.issue_category: Source code / localized catalog synchronization gap
checklist_answers.documented_procedure: VectorCraft i18n test suite mandates 100% catalog coverage for all engine command labels and Other() error messages across complete languages
checklist_answers.pre_build_validation: Check existing error message reuse and update all 7 language TSVs whenever new command specs or Other() errors are introduced

evidence.summary: ja: 4 untranslated menu strings: ['Cluster by Color', 'Group by Color', 'Render Labeled Overlay', 'Semantic Document Summary'] and es: 2 untranslated messages: ['PNG encoding failed: {e}', 'can't render: the area or resolution is empty, inverted or not finite']

fix_applied: Reused existing translated error message in menucmds.rs, converted PNG encoding error to bad(...), and added the 4 missing command translations across ja.tsv, es.tsv, it.tsv, zh-hans.tsv, zh-hant.tsv, pt-br.tsv, cs.tsv.
